tweets.text: On Thursday, an El Paso AS350 crew was requested by the U.S. Marshals Service to provide overwatch of a barricaded subject. A few minutes after the crew arrived on station, the barricaded subject exited the residence and handed himself over to U.S. Marshals without incident.  Great teamwork to bring this dangerous situation to a peaceful ending. #ProtectingAmerica

The individuals were turned over the to the U.S. Border Patrol San Clemente Station. #BorderSecurity #DontTake2TheSea

tweets.text: METH SMUGGLERS COOKED!  On Saturday, a San Diego Air and Marine Branch Multi-Role Enforcement Aircraft conducting a border security mission detected a target of interest south of Dana Point, California. The aircrew coordinated with a Long Beach Marine Unit Coastal Interceptor crew to successfully intercept the vessel resulting in the arrest of 2 Mexican nationals and the seizure of 664 lbs. of Methamphetamine. This is what protecting America looks like! #BorderSecurity
